TT-P34: Neuroprotective Macrocyclic Peptide — Research Dossier

Research compounds discussed for educational purposes only. Not FDA-approved for human use.

What Is TT-P34?

TT-P34 is a Phase 1 neuroprotective macrocyclic peptide (11 amino acids) derived from SorCS2, developed by Teitur Trophics (Copenhagen). Phase 1 results (September 2026): BBB penetration confirmed, CSF lysosomal biomarkers engaged in Parkinson's patients. Phase 2 planned 2027.
